title: Remove clutch, pressure plate and dual-mass flywheel

notices.text: Lock the flywheel before loosening. Loosen the pressure plate bolts in a star pattern a turn at a time so the cover does not distort. The DMF is heavy — do not let it drop on the crank flange or the dowel. Before discarding, check the DMF: rotational free play (rock the secondary mass against the primary), radial rock, and any rattling or evidence of grease thrown out past the seal. Porsche/LuK spec a diagnostic tool for this; if in doubt on a 20-year-old car with the engine already out, replace it. THE FLYWHEEL BOLTS ARE TORQUE-TO-YIELD AND MUST NOT BE REUSED.

steps.text: Remove clutch, pressure plate and dual-mass flywheel.

fasteners.name: Dual-mass flywheel bolts (M96)

stages.label: M10 x 1 x 50, 12.9 (8 off): stage 1 25 Nm (19 ft-lb), stage 2 +90 deg.

fasteners.note: New bolts. Torque-then-angle with an angle gauge.

sources.ref: Knowledge Gruppe, Fastening Specifications 996, p.19 item 18 (M96.03 row); WSM Gr.1 Part 1 (M96/01 edition) p.1-2
